title: The school band, piano, and starting to write
summary: The school band ran 35 to 50 pieces; he played just enough piano to work out ideas and began writing at 'Bama State without formal theory.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
